# Signal Fish Godot Client

> Godot bindings for the Signal Fish protocol, focused on GDScript support
> across major Godot versions and Godot 4 web exports.

## Core Context

- [Canonical AI Context](./.llm/context.md): Required starting point for agents.
- [Generated LLM Index](./.llm/index.md): Inventory of available skills,
  samples, and research notes.
